title: 28 Indian startups pitch air pollution solutions to VCs at AirEarth.org event
summary: AirEarth.org hosted 28 Indian clean-air startups pitching to VCs like Blume and Rainmatter, pushing year-round pollution fixes.
llm_summary: AirEarth.org convened 28 Indian clean‑air startups for a pitch‑day, showcasing technologies that tackle year‑round air‑pollution challenges—from monitoring sensors to emissions‑capture solutions. Venture‑capital firms such as Blume Ventures and Rainmatter backed the event, signaling growing investor appetite for scalable, India‑focused pollution‑control innovations.
